# LLM Full Context: Case Studies

## Implementing Salesforce Agentforce for a LATAM Battery Retailer
title: Implementing Salesforce Agentforce for a LATAM Battery Retailer
summary: End-to-end AI agent deployment at a mid-size distributor — from architecture to client alignment, across two languages and two teams. Skyblux Solutions is a consulting firm specializing in Salesforce implementations for Latin American clients. My internship placed me on a 12-week project implementing Salesforce Agentforce for a mid-size battery distributor — giving them an AI-driven agent for customer service and sales support via WhatsApp.
role: AI Implementation Intern
company: Skyblux Solutions
timeline: Summer 2025
key outcomes:
- Delivered production-ready Agentforce implementation on schedule across 12 weeks
- Built modular component library (50+ instruction blocks, 15+ agent actions, 12+ flows) that enabled rapid iteration under repeated scope changes
- Maintained alignment across a bilingual engineering/client split throughout the project
- Created implementation guide and documentation standardizing architecture patterns for future Agentforce deployments
source URL: https://francescodm6.github.io/work/skyblux-agentforce
